comparison.objective: Extract a case leaning on a locker door and place it upright without tipping or dropping, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually support a load while opening an obstructed door and transporting it upright.
comparison.success_condition: Case never exceeds tip/drop limits and stands released on the mat.
comparison.reason: Load support during access and transport tests a different physical skill and outcome.
